d: Huawei OSX010000 is a hot-pluggable 10 Gbps SFP+ optical transceiver designed for long-range 10 Gigabit Ethernet connectivity over single-mode fiber. It complies with the 10GBASE-LR standard, operates at a wavelength of 1310 nm, supports transmission distances up to 10 km, and features a duplex LC optical interface with Digital Diagnostic Monitoring (DDM).
